verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents a public API v2. It ships official SDKs in six languages, a sandbox API, scoped API keys, OAuth 2.0, documented rate-limit behavior with Retry-After, and region endpoints, and a probe confirmed a reachable llms.txt that indexes the API docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving jobs through the API beyond first-party docs and the llms.txt probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: For API v2, official PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java and .NET SDKs are available.
The sandbox API allows you to perform unlimited jobs and tasks without consuming your credits.
When creating an API key, you can select scopes to limit access.
If the limit is reached, a 429 error is returned, and there is a Retry-After header with the time in seconds to wait before the next request.
This is the documentation for the CloudConvert API.
